description: Embedded software development for next-generation smart AC EV charging stations (EVSE). Working on an ARM-based SoC with a custom Linux distribution built with Yocto, structured as modular C++ applications communicating through an IPC message bus.

Software consulting and development for third parties. Led the E-Mobility software development team at Scame SPA, managing complex EVSE projects including OCPP implementation, smart charging algorithms, and custom Linux distributions with Yocto.

Worked in the telecommunications sector alongside university studies. Handled customer service operations and took on Team Leader responsibilities from January 2021, managing team workflows and performance.
Academic internship in the quality control laboratory. Testing of electrical devices for regulatory compliance.
